verdict.rationale: Viam has a Registry providing pre-built drivers/modules for common hardware (cameras, motors, arms, sensors) that viam-server pulls automatically based on config, plus 'pre-built modules or build your own' for reusable behaviors, and searchable models by manufacturer/type. This is well-documented first-party but lacks independent hands-on corroboration of registry breadth/quality. Missing for 10: independent/community verification of registry module quality and coverage, and any registry browsing UI/API evidence beyond docs claims.
